newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Formosa group jumps on word of US expansion.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Formosa group jumps on word of US expansion.

text.p: Members of Formosa Plastics group, Taiwan's top industrial conglomerate, soared in early Wednesday trade, fuelled by news of major expansion plan for a petrochemical complex in the United States, brokers said.
Formosa Plastics Corp, a key member of the group, said on Wednesday it had applied to the U.S. government for permits for an US$800 million expansion at a plant in Texas.
After 60 minutes, Formosa Plastics was up T$2.5 or four percent to T$65.
Two other key group members -- Nan Ya Plastics and Formosa Chemical and Fiber -- gained T$3.5 or 6.54 percent to T$57 and 80 cents or 2.09 percent to T$39.1.
The Formosa group's surge triggered a 2.85 percent rise for the entire plastics and chemical sector in early trading.
Recent projections of big leaps in profits after Formosa's new petrochemical plant opens in 1999 also drew continued buying from investors oriented toward the long term, brokers said.

"Optimism towards Formosa is fuelled by both long-term and short-term oriented investors," said Tsao Chung-ping of Ting Kong Securities. "Recent reports provide good excuses for both types of investors to buy Formosa stocks."
